item.title: Sony Officially Confirms Major PS5 Hardware Sales Milestone
item.description: Hardware sales may be down across the board in the video game industry, but that hasn't stopped Sony from reaching a major new PlayStation 5 sales milestone this year. The multimedia giant achieved its latest impressive sales feat prior to the holiday rush and before the highly-anticipated release of Grand Theft Auto 6 to boot.

item.title: 'GTA 6' Meets 'Heat' in the Most Disappointing Heist Thriller of 2026
item.description: Directed by David Leitch ( Bullet Train , The Fall Guy ), How to Rob a Bank taps directly into the visceral frustration with financial institutions, corporate greed, and the systemic squeeze of modern life. At the center of its story is ex-military-turned-bank-robber Ryan (Nicholas Hoult), who leads a small band of thieves including his wife Emi (Anna Sawai), military buddy Vince (Pete Davidson), and content mastermind Hugo (Rhenzy Feliz) in brazen exploits posted to their YouTube channel, "How to Rob a Bank." As the film opens, they’re already fast on their way to becoming internet sensations, with Ryan donning a fox mask as he lectures viewers about class disparity and the mounting inefficiencies of the modern economy. Out to thwart them is Agent John West (John C. Reilly), who enlists the help of Reagan (Zoe Kravitz), a weed-loving, Cheeto-addicted programmer on house arrest.

item.title: Bethesda Officially Shuts Down Elder Scrolls 6 Fan Theory on Skyrim Anniversary
item.description: The Elder Scrolls 6 was first announced in 2018, and we really haven't learned much about Bethesda's next big RPG in the years since then. That finally changed earlier this month, when Bethesda Game Studios director Todd Howard revealed the game's subtitle : Sentinel . It came with a short teaser trailer, which, while incredibly thin, has spawned a number of theories. If you were hoping the logo reveal would be the start of more frequent announcements about the long-awaited follow-up to Skyrim , Bethesda has some bad news for you.

item.title: Forgotten Elder Scrolls Game Gets Surprise Re-Release
item.description: Today is The Elder Scrolls: Skyrim ’s fifteenth anniversary, a sentence so shocking it’s liable to turn your bones to dust. With the series entering 15 years without a new mainline entry and Bethesda Game Studios showing no signs of announcing news about The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel , a fan is helping fill the void by re-releasing an obscure series spinoff.

item.title: How to get the Zora Tunic in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Once you get the Zora Tunic in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, you'll be ready to explore the waters of Hyrule. Before you obtain this tunic, the only way to explore underwater is by diving, and even if you have the Golden Scale , Link always has to come up for air. However, after you get the tunic — and a pair of special boots — you'll be able to freely walk under the water. Besides, you must have the tunic to progress the story and complete the Water Temple .

item.title: 'VisionQuest' Star Officially Comments Status in 'Avengers: Doomsday' and 'Secret Wars'
item.description: Throughout VisionQuest , the character Jocasta has been full of surprises. Played by T’Nia Miller , Jocasta is dramatically different here than the version we've seen in Marvel Comics , but these changes were necessary given how much the Marvel Cinematic Universe changed Ultron’s story.

item.title: Patrick Stewart Made Anthony Mackie ‘Freak Out’ on Avengers: Doomsday Set
item.description: Patrick Stewart died on Oct. 28, meaning that his performance as Professor Charles Xavier in Avengers: Doomsday will be the last of his long career. Stewart first played the telepathic mutant in Bryan Singer’s X-Men in 2000, leading the superhero team in the fight against Ian McKellen’s Magneto. The two actors had met decades before at the Royal Shakespeare Company, but they became close friends after working together on the X-Men films. The actors reunited for Avengers: Doomsday , and Anthony Mackie said he and his The Falcon and the Winter Soldier co-star Sebastian Stan were so excited about it that they embarrassed themselves.

item.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore Officially Gets Disney Plus Streaming Date
item.description: With Avengers: Doomsday roughly a month away, Disney just delivered some good news for MCU fans who want to be fully caught up before Doctor Doom blows through the Marvel pantheon. Avengers Endgame: Encore is coming to Disney Plus very soon.

item.title: My Grandma Got Me Through the Water Temple. She Would’ve Loved the Ocarina of Time Remake
item.description: For a while it was the NES . I’d shoot ducks until I got bored, and I hated Mario because it was too hard. What I really remember fondly was watching Mémère play The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past after she upgraded to the SNES. She’d tell me who she was fighting and why, and following along felt like having one of my favorite people read me a book. When it was my turn to play, I’d just charge up Link’s sword and mow every blade of grass I could find. Then I’d go looking for chickens. Then I’d ask what she had for snacks. She always had good snacks for me.

item.title: Lanterns Producer Officially Responds to Show Cancellation Rumors
item.description: DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran stepped down from their posts on Monday. Skydance, which recently acquired DC parent company Warner Bros. Discovery, replaced them with former Marvel producer Jeremy Latcham, resulting in plenty of questions about the future of the nascent DC Universe . Rumors swirled that the hit DCU show Lanterns , which recently wrapped up its first season, was canceled after Variety reported it wasn't renewed; it was later updated to say the show "has yet" to be renewed for season 2.
